title: Share video
description: Create a clip or export the whole battle. No screen recording needed.
shareHint: Share the file to an app, or save it for later.
saveHint: Save the file, then attach it to your social post.
progressHint: Keep LoB open until your preview is ready. You can cancel at any time.
invalidRange: Choose a valid starting and ending turn.
tooLarge: This file is too large for an in-browser export. Try fewer turns or 720p.
encoderUnavailable: The video encoder could not load. Check your connection and try again.
exportStalled: The export stopped responding. Please try again.
emptyReplay: There is no battle footage in this range. Choose another turn.
exportFailed: The video could not be created. Try a shorter clip or lower quality.
shareFailed: The file could not be shared. Try saving it and attaching it to your post.
gifSilent: GIF has no sound. Choose MP4 for audio.
durationHint: Fits all selected turns and the lineup into this duration.
invalidDuration: Enter a duration of at least 1 second.
